# سَنَد — SANAD Sovereign News Intelligence
> منصّة إخبارية عربية تطبّق علم الإسناد من علم الحديث على الأخبار: لكلِّ خبرٍ درجةٌ
> (صحيح / حسن / ضعيف الإسناد) محسوبةٌ من خمسة معايير معلنة، ومصدرٌ معروضٌ للقارئ.
> An Arabic news platform applying hadith-science chain-of-transmission (isnad)
> grading to news: every story carries a computed grade and a visible source.

## Data (JSON, machine-readable, CC-attribution)
- News (graded, by section): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldiomAI/sanad-data/main/daily/news.json
- Daily bulletin (script + audio ref): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldiomAI/sanad-data/main/daily/latest.json
- Official wire (state agencies): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldiomAI/sanad-data/main/daily/official.json
- Rumor rulings with sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldiomAI/sanad-data/main/daily/rumors.json
- Official public alerts: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldiomAI/sanad-data/main/daily/alerts.json
- AI research papers digest (Al-Warraq): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldiomAI/sanad-data/main/daily/papers.json
- Regional instability index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldiomAI/sanad-data/main/daily/tension.json
- Pipeline health (honest status): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldiomAI/sanad-data/main/daily/health.json
- Everything in one request: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldiomAI/sanad-data/main/daily/bundle.json

## Method
- Grades: صحيح (authentic, first-degree source + corroboration), حسن (sound outlet),
  ضعيف الإسناد (weak chain). Five criteria: الاتصال (connection), عدالة المصدر
  (source integrity), الضبط (precision), عدم الشذوذ (non-anomaly), انتفاء العلة (no defect).
- Fully automated agent newsroom; agents and their live status: /daily/agents.json
- Verification guide for readers: https://isnad.news/

## Attribution
Data may be reused with attribution to سَنَد (SANAD) — https://isnad.news
